a: React Query (TanStack Query) manages server state, caching, and refetching.
Context passes data through the tree without prop drilling.
useReducer manages complex state transitions with pure reducers.
useRef holds mutable values that do not trigger re-renders.
Strict Mode highlights potential problems in development.
Suspense coordinates loading states for lazy components and data.
Portals render children into a different DOM node.
Error boundaries catch render errors in the component tree.
Coordinate multiple loading indicators carefully for UX.
Server Components render on the server and reduce client JS.
